impact: Leadership uncertainty is a key reason for the AI and memory selloff into Tuesday's earnings; any clarity on succession could swing NVDA and, with it, NBIS, MU, DRAM and SNXX.
summary: The FT reported Sunday that Jensen Huang is considering a return as Nvidia CEO while Silicon Valley allies, including Elon Musk, lobby the board; an open letter backing him passed 175,000 names by Monday. The board has opened an independent investigation, is searching for a permanent CEO, and Treasury Secretary Bessent reportedly favors an outside hire. Huang lacks a controlling stake, and interim CEO Colette Kress presents results Tuesday.
title: Jensen Huang weighs Nvidia CEO return as allies lobby the board
